canonical: Create a canonical character reference sheet for PixelRick, a desktop pet: recognizable Rick Sanchez from Rick and Morty as a charming chibi pixel-art sprite, blue spiky hair, pale skin, unibrow, tired expressive eyes, long white lab coat, cyan shirt, brown pants, black shoes. Large head small body short legs, 2 to 2.5 heads tall. TRUE crisp low-resolution pixel art, limited 20-color palette, dark slate pixel outline, no antialiasing or gradients. Sheet arranged in a clean 3-column 2-row grid: top row full-body neutral FRONT, LEFT PROFILE, RIGHT PROFILE; bottom row enlarged facial reference neutral and annoyed, and palette swatches. Each full-body figure entirely visible with generous separate margins, identical character height and proportions. Transparent background. The full-body designs should read well downsampled to 90 pixels tall on a 128x128 canvas. No props, no effects, no ground shadows. This establishes one canonical design for all later animations.
